cohort: full male load_and_prepare cohort (1082 rows / 267 subjects)
km_definition: KM 90% = product-limit 90% quantile of time to first OBSERVED Y>=4% per subject; never-observed right-censored at last observed week
gamm_definition: GAMM-Binomial 90% coverage week = earliest week with marginal p(t,bmi)>=0.9, averaged over BMI grid levels in the band
caveat: The two statistics answer different questions (per-subject event-time quantile vs per-draw marginal-probability threshold); they are aligned on the same cohort and BMI bands but are not interchangeable.
